title: fisc client mark
description: A node the client makes and no document carries: the aggregate a cap folds a column's tail into, the residual carrying flow a drawn document does not decompose, the gap holding a licensed difference between two schedules, and the smaller-flows mark the reader's smallest-flow filter folds small printed ribbons onto. Go writes none and refuses a producer node wearing one; site/marks.test.mjs holds every mark the client builds to this shape. Every figure on one is a sum over cited ribbons, and it says so in its rationale and source note like any derived node.

id.description: The mark's prefix names its role; export.MarkPrefixes.

parent.description: The opened node an aggregate or a residual hangs under; empty for a gap, which belongs to neither document, and for a smaller-flows mark, which spans whatever its ribbons reach; both are drawn muted.

constraint_tier.description: A mark reads no fund type: the key is present so a mark is shaped like a node, and empty because no page classifies it.

derived.description: The invariant: the city printed no such line.

folds.description: The ids an aggregate stands for, which no parent chain records.

locators.description: A gap's citations, the pages cited around the node it stands beside; a smaller-flows mark's, every page its merged ribbons cite.

carried_from.description: The stem of the document a mark was carried from into a window, set by the window and never cleared.

allOf.description: An aggregate names what it folded, and folds at least two: an aggregate of one is worse than none.
A residual carries two figures, what flows in and what flows out, which need not balance.
A gap carries its difference on one side and cites the pages around the node it stands beside.
